summaries.zh: 该开源项目名为 **ponytail**，主要功能是让 AI 智能体像团队里“最懒的资深开发”一样思考，强调“最好的代码是没写出来的代码”，即鼓励减少不必要的编码。项目使用 JavaScript 编写，目前在 GitHub 上拥有约 12.9 万星标和 6900 余次 Fork，受到广泛关注。
summaries.en: DietrichGebert/ponytail is a JavaScript project designed to influence AI agent behavior by making it adopt the mindset of a "lazy senior developer." Its core philosophy is that the best code is code never written, aiming to reduce unnecessary output and promote minimal, efficient action. The repository is highly popular, with approximately 129,074 stars and 6,914 forks, indicating significant community interest. Its purpose is focused on guiding AI toward simpler, more decisive solutions by prioritizing restraint and avoiding over-engineering in code generation.
